We are looking for a Process Controller for our site in Hilversum . Are you analytically strong, structured in your work, and able to switch easily between different processes? Then this position could be the right fit for you. 
As a Process Controller, you ensure that everything in the warehouse runs smoothly. You monitor order flows and maintain oversight of the daily operation. Do you notice a problem or delay? Then you act quickly and make timely adjustments where needed. 
What will you do ? - Monitor the Warehouse Management System (WMS). - Oversee turnaround times for incoming and outgoing trucks. - Contribute to a safe, efficient, and high-quality working environment. - Administratively process and register incoming goods. - Plan and coordinate outgoing orders within the warehouse. 
What do you bring? - MBO+ level working and thinking ability (equivalent to vocational education with higher-level practical thinking skills). - Experience in a logistics environment is an advantage. - Experience with WMS systems and logistics processes is a plus. - Strong communication skills and a proactive attitude. - Good level of Dutch and English essential. (At least B2 level) - A sense of responsibility and a true team player. - Availability for preferably 40 hours per week. 
What can you expect? 
You will be working at a logistics organization in Hilversum where collaboration, development, and initiative are central. You will have the opportunity to contribute ideas and further develop yourself.
